title: Who wants to help Cards Against Humanity f*** with Elon Musk?
excerpt: We got Musk off our land. Let's build a monument to remind him he's a sad little b**** with no friends.
content_html:
What’s happening?

We have forced Elon Musk to get the fuck off our land, and now it’s time to build something on it—a monument to remind Musk that he’s a sad little bitch with no friends. For $10, you can help us design that monument, or you can support the cause by getting one of our new expansions (10% of profits go toward the monument).

Where's the land?

Our beautiful land is located on the US-Mexico border, right on the Rio Grande. Once a pristine riverfront property, it was illegally defiled by Elon Musk two years ago and then annexed into “Starbase, Texas” (his creepy company town). On both sides of our land, Musk is building mansions for his harem of prostitutes executives, who we’re confident will enjoy seeing our monument whenever they look out the window.

What are the new expansions?

The Super Box is a big expansion with 300 brand new cards for 2026—the dumbest year yet. The Bad Billionaires Pack is all about miserable sociopaths like Musk, and the Big Balls Pack is about…balls. To get both packs, grab the Big Bad Bundle, which also includes some packs you missed and 10 bonus cards about Donald Trump’s best friend, Jeffrey Epstein.

What does it mean to join the Elon Musk is a Sad Little Bitch with No Friends Monument Design Committee?

Designing and constructing a grand monument to force a moment of introspection upon the world’s richest, ugliest man will require creativity and commitment. You’ll get to make suggestions, vote between options, be part of a community, and brag to your friends that you helped Cards Against Humanity fuck with Elon Musk.

How do I join the Monument Design Committee?

There are two easy ways: you can click this link and join directly for $10, or you can buy anything on the CAH Store and you’ll be able to join the committee for $10 during checkout (it will be obvious).

Won’t Musk stop all of this?

No, it’s our land, which we own and he doesn't. If SpaceX tries to violate our property rights again, we’ll forward their legal threats to everyone on the committee—so you, too, can experience the thrill of participating in legal action with Elon Musk!

Is the money I pay to join the Monument Design Committee tax deductible?

Sadly, no. Unlike Elon, we’re not willing to commit tax fraud.

Can I get the Super Box or Big Bad Bundle from other places, like Amazon or Target?

You sure can, but we’re only donating profits from orders placed directly with us. So, if you want the expansions but you’re afraid of Elon Musk, you can support Jeff Bezos here: Super Box, Big Bad Bundle. Or whoever the fuck the CEO of Target is here: Super Box, Big Bad Bundle.

Why do you keep calling Elon Musk “a sad little bitch with no friends”?

Great question! (1) He is sad, (2) he is a bitch, and (3) he has no friends.

Did Elon Musk spend his 47th birthday alone, with no friends?

Yes.

Did Elon Musk beg Jeffrey Epstein for an invitation to his island, but get rejected?

Yes.

You’re saying that even the world’s most infamous pedophile didn’t want to be Elon Musk’s friend?

Yes.

Is Elon Musk a loser?

We at Cards Against Humanity have debated this question at length. In some ways, no. But in most ways...yes.

content_html_zh:
发生了什么事？

我们已经迫使埃隆·马斯克离开我们的土地，现在是时候在上面建造一些东西了——一座纪念碑，提醒马斯克他是一个没有朋友的可悲的小母狗。 只需 10 美元，您就可以帮助我们设计该纪念碑，或者您也可以通过购买我们的新扩建项目之一来支持这一事业（10% 的利润将用于纪念碑）。

土地在哪里？

我们美丽的土地位于美国和墨西哥边境，紧邻格兰德河。 它曾经是一处原始的河滨地产，两年前被埃隆·马斯克非法玷污，然后并入“德克萨斯州斯塔基地”（他令人毛骨悚然的公司城镇）。 在我们土地的两侧，马斯克正在为他的妓女高管后宫建造豪宅，我们相信，每当他们向窗外看去时，他们都会喜欢看到我们的纪念碑。

有哪些新的扩展？

Super Box 是一个大型扩展包，为 2026 年（迄今为止最愚蠢的一年）提供了 300 张全新卡牌。 《坏亿万富翁包》是关于像马斯克这样悲惨的反社会者的，而《大球包》是关于……球的。 要获得这两个包，请购买 Big Bad Bundle，其中还包括一些您错过的包和 10 张有关唐纳德·特朗普最好的朋友杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的奖励卡。

加入埃隆·马斯克是一个没有朋友的悲伤小母狗纪念碑设计委员会意味着什么？

设计和建造一座宏伟的纪念碑，迫使世界上最富有、最丑陋的人进行反思，需要创造力和承诺。 你可以提出建议，在选项之间进行投票，成为社区的一员，并向你的朋友吹嘘你帮助反人类卡片组织与埃隆·马斯克进行了性交。

如何加入纪念碑设计委员会？

有两种简单的方法：您可以点击此链接并直接以 10 美元的价格加入，或者您可以在 CAH 商店上购买任何东西，然后在结账时以 10 美元的价格加入委员会（这是显而易见的）。

马斯克不会阻止这一切吗？

不，这是我们的土地，我们拥有，而他不拥有。 如果 SpaceX 再次试图侵犯我们的财产权，我们会将他们的法律威胁转发给委员会中的每个人，这样您也可以体验与埃隆·马斯克一起参与法律诉讼的快感！

我加入纪念碑设计委员会所缴纳的费用可以免税吗？

遗憾的是，没有。 与埃隆不同，我们不愿意进行税务欺诈。

我可以从其他地方（例如 Amazon 或 Target）购买 Super Box 或 Big Bad Bundle 吗？

您当然可以，但我们仅捐赠直接向我们下的订单的利润。 所以，如果你想要扩展，但又害怕埃隆·马斯克，你可以在这里支持杰夫·贝索斯：Super Box, Big Bad Bundle。 或者不管谁他妈的塔吉特首席执行官在这里：超级盒子，大坏包。

为什么你一直称埃隆·马斯克为“一个没有朋友的悲伤小母狗”？

好问题！ （1）他很伤心，（2）他是个婊子，（3）他没有朋友。

埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 47 岁生日是在没有朋友的情况下独自度过的吗？

Yes.

埃隆·马斯克是否曾请求杰弗里·爱泼斯坦邀请他去他的岛屿，但遭到拒绝？

Yes.

你是说，即使是世界上最臭名昭著的恋童癖者也不想成为埃隆·马斯克的朋友？

Yes.

埃隆·马斯克是一个失败者吗？

我们反人类卡牌组织已经详细讨论过这个问题。 在某些方面，不。 但在大多数方面......是的。
